description: Moves a [colophon] section to the back of the book and renders it as back matter — after every chapter, with no page number and absent from the contents list. Asciidoctor already renders a [colophon] section, but as an ordinary numbered chapter wherever it was written; reordering the source cannot make it back matter. Set :colophon-placement: document to leave it exactly where it was written.
sampleContent: A [colophon] section is moved to the back of the book, unnumbered and absent from the contents list.
